Lines before the first snippet are not assembled.

The reduced AVR-tiny core (-mmcu=avrtiny, -m avrtiny).

=== AVR-tiny direct load and store
        .text
        .set    var, 0x60
        lds     r16, var
        sts     var + 1, r17
        lds     r31, 0xbf
        ret

=== refused: rcall out of reach, which GNU ld does not wrap for this core
        .text
        rcall   far
        .space  0x1000
far:    ret
